{"consolidated_memory":"**Offline Cache Data Loss: Four Separate Incidents and Fixes**

Component: mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side, Kotlin)
Covering test: mobile/android/OfflineCacheTest.kt

Common symptom across all incidents: data loss manifesting as a local row missing after app restart. Reproduction: force stop the app with unsynced edits.

---

**Incident 1: [2026-02-15] OAuth Provider Sessions**
Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Affected: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
Fix: Added composite index and backfilled in batches
PR #4257, branch fix/data-loss-1
Result: Error rate dropped from 9.7% to under 3 per 10,000 (0.03%)

**Incident 2: [2026-04-15] Unbounded Retry Loop**
Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
Affected: Sessions after client had already retried once
Fix: Capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
PR #5907, branch fix/data-loss-2
Result: Reclaimed 69 GB of blob storage

**Incident 3: [2026-06-03] Large Payloads**
Root cause: Serializer dropping unknown fields
Affected: Payloads above approximately 2 megabytes
Fix: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
PR #6274, branch fix/data-loss-3
Result: Job execution time reduced from 2 hours to 42 minutes

**Incident 4: [2026-08-13] Large Tenant Key Sets**
Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
Affected: Tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
Fix: Switched deadline calculation to monotonic clock
PR #8740, branch fix/data-loss-4
Result: Backlog cleared 33 minutes after deployment"}
